name: zonked
description: Calm sound for tired minds. Soft tones, noise and nature sounds, made on your device. Free, private, no account, works offline. Safe volume limits are built in. Not a medical device.
author: Zonked contributors
highlights: Free, no account, no ads, no tracking.
Works offline. Sound is made on your device.
Safe volume: slow fade in and a hard cap on loudness.
239 sounds, 22 nature loops, a breathing session and a 25 plus 5 study sprint.
Optional Crew link: the sound can ease down when a long coding session gets heavy.

tools.name: zonked_report_intensity
tools.title: Report session intensity
tools.description: Burnout sentinel only. Report the 0-100 burnout score and the signals behind it. The backend clamps every value and decides if the sound should change.

tools.name: zonked_get_suggestion
tools.title: Get the sound suggestion
tools.description: Acoustic sequencer. Returns the current safe sound target and why the backend holds or changes it. Read only.

crons.name: burnout-check
crons.message: Measure the session intensity and report it with zonked_report_intensity. Report once, then stop.

panelTabs.title: Zonked
panelTabs.menuDescription: Play or stop your calm sound from the side panel.
